English: Earthen Pit
A simple pit dug into the ground, lined with straw to keep harvested rice dry and safe for a short time. Basic but effective for the first arrivals.
Woven Basket
Lightweight, portable bamboo baskets keep rice dry and allow clans to move with the harvest. Encourages mobility and growth.
Mudbrick Silo
A sturdy silo built from sun-dried mudbricks, protecting rice from monsoons and pests. Marks a settled, semi-permanent phase.
Raised Granary
A weather-resistant, elevated rice granary on wooden stilts, defending grain from floods and vermin while supporting larger clans.
Guarded Storehouse
A fortified storehouse with guards, deterring raiders and ensuring safe rice storage for the entire clan. Requires construction technology.
Rodent-Proof Hut
Ingenious huts with sealed floors and hanging baskets, entirely protecting the rice harvest from pests. Requires improved construction.
Expanded Store
A vast, compartmentalized rice store, able to supply large clans and sustain armies on campaign. Shows advanced social organization.
Market Pavilion
A bustling pavilion where clans trade rice, goods, and livestock. Serves as a hub for prestige and unity.
Grain Exchange Hall
A grand exchange hall where rice is bartered, prices set, and disputes settled. Central to the clans economy and growth.
Dravidian Rice Granary
An immense, stone-reinforced granary, symbol of clan prosperity. Enables unmatched population and military growth, and cements the Dravidian nomads as masters of rice and trade.
